findings.source_quote: “upon the earth distress of nations, with perplexity; the sea and the waves roaring; Men’s hearts failing them for fear, and for looking after those things which are coming on the earth”
findings.suggested_fix: In both quotations, revise the wording to keep the clauses distinct and preserve their meaning—for example: “地上的列国必有困苦，心中困惑；海浪翻腾；人因惧怕，又因期待那将临到世界的事，心都吓得衰竭……” Keep the existing HTML structure and Scripture references unchanged.
findings.translation_quote: “地上的邦国也有困苦，因海中波浪的响声，就慌慌不定；人因惧怕，并因盼望那将要临到世界的事，就吓得魂不附体”
